releases.title: Edit your meals
notes: Logged something wrong? Tap any food on the Today screen (or the pencil icon) to fix its name, meal, calories, protein, carbs, fat and more.
Ate more or less than you logged? Use the ½× to 2× buttons to scale the whole entry at once.
Plato now tells you when a new version is out. Tap Update to get it, and you'll see what changed.
